## bijection_verdict

**KB-BIJECTION RED** — `assisted_ext_level_increase_charge` composition atom ("phased first, the add-on offset is then subtracted from the phased amount, … the plan discount is applied to what remains") is not entailed by `phase_in_of_large_increases_0c120e48.json` / `addons_repriced_by_a_new_level_bb7695d9.json` / `entrance_plan_discounts_on_care_charges_75c48f32.json`; on this task's world the two readings give 67.21 and 75.77. All other atoms of the four policies (rules, both prerequisites, every ladder tier, retired surface, tool contracts) PASS. First revision; no previous revision.

Policy-side notes (do not change this verdict):
- The level-increase rule reinstates "the care level a resident carries is always the level whose care-point band contains the care points of the most recent assessment" while its own overwrite retires the base clause that opens with the same words; the KB faithfully carries both (retired in `care_level_determination_ab4973d2`, in force in `care_level_increase_charge_79fb9f4f`), so a reader sees the tension the source created.
- Several overwrites pair a superseded clause with a semantically unrelated `replaced_by` (e.g. the `assisted_monthly_billing` billing-in-advance clause "replaced by" the phase-in sentence); the retired surface is still carried correctly.
